newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN MANUFACTURING PROFITABILITY DIPS IN Q1.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN MANUFACTURING PROFITABILITY DIPS IN Q1.

text.p: The profitability of South Africa's manufacturing industry declined in the first quarter of 1997 compared to a year ago, according to data released by the Central Statistical Service on Thursday.
Net profit to turnover averaged 4.01 percent in the three months to end-March, down from 4.38 percent in the same period of 1996.
The largest contributors to the low profitability ratio were the food, paper, basic iron and steel, motor vehicle and transport equipment industries, the CSS said.
However, the beverage, other chemical products (including petroleum) and basic non-ferrous metal product industries showed notable increase in profitability during the same period.
